cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. These minutes say 'discussion of my proposal.' What did you leave out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. 'Nobody' sounds crowded. Who wanted my name out of it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present, to save your proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who else? You've recorded my rescue very carefully without naming my replacement.

mechanism: A marks its former minute-taker omissions as unfinished training in order to uncover the concealed replacement of A as presenter.
confusable: Not mere grammar correction: demands for named actors progressively reveal the personally threatening decision.
comparison: Emotional tact between siblings versus colleague minutes.
seedUse: D102 minutes/proposal/nobody/replacement; S05 taught naming decisions and actions.
